profile_page_template.map_region: fixed lower-48 map occupying 45–50 percent of usable width
profile_page_template.alaska_region: labeled point inset when events exist; explicit no-retained-event statement otherwise
profile_page_template.side_region: five-category side composition with exact counts and denominator
profile_page_template.content_region: wage channel, one bounded example, final claim boundary, and main limitation
profile_page_template.caption_region: 70–115 words; no process-history or revision language
profile_page_template.technical_footer: exact analytical unit, fixed grid, evidence-not-prevalence boundary

appendix_template.page_1: 11 reader-facing categories with fewer than 25 events, grouped as compact cards with exact counts and point locations
appendix_template.page_2: three classification outcomes in a separate status table, including exact Alaska status
appendix_template.density_rule: no Alaska density hexes and no sparse-category density shading

claim_policy: final claim IDs, classes, and wording remain unchanged
public_copy_policy: standalone language only; no revised, corrected, prior-version, cleanup, lane, task, or internal workflow wording
alaska_policy: point inset for retained profile events; explicit none otherwise; exact point/table treatment in sparse/status appendix
